tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild normocytic anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, and basophilia. There is also mild hypoglycemia. Electrolytes, renal, and liver function are within normal limits. Findings suggest possible bone marrow suppression or infiltration, and the severe hypoxemia is clinically significant and requires urgent attention. Correlation with clinical context is recommended.
